Manish Kumar | manish.kumar442@example.com | +91 9638783988
Hyderabad

Professional Summary
DevOps-focused engineer with experience operating CI/CD, container orchestration, and observability for high-availability services. Skilled in automating deployments, infrastructure as code, and monitoring to improve release velocity and system reliability.

Technical Skills
Kubernetes, Terraform, S3, SQS, Lambda, Docker, Jenkins, Linux, Helm, Prometheus, Grafana, GitHub Actions, Confluence, Jira

Work Experience

DevOps Engineer, PhonePe (Jan 2026 - Present)
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions to automate build, test, and deployment workflows for microservices, reducing deployment time by ~40%.
- Packaged applications as Helm charts and managed Kubernetes deployments on EKS, enabling consistent rollouts and rollback capabilities.
- Instrumented services with Grafana dashboards and Prometheus metrics to track latency, error rates, and resource usage; improved alerting to reduce mean time to detect.
- Hardened container images and automated image scanning in the pipeline; resolved recurring failures through Linux-level troubleshooting.

Site Reliability Engineer, Helio Energy (Dec 2025 - Dec 2025)
- Provisioned repeatable infrastructure using Terraform modules for staging environments, improving environment parity and reducing setup time.
- Integrated Prometheus-based monitoring across services and created dashboards to surface key SLIs, enabling faster incident response.
- Collaborated via Confluence and Jira to document runbooks and track reliability improvements for critical systems.

DevOps Engineer, Freshworks (Aug 2024 - Nov 2025)
- Built and maintained GitHub Actions workflows to support CI for multiple repositories, reducing merge-to-deploy lead time.
- Adopted Helm for templated deployments to Kubernetes, simplifying multi-environment configuration and deployments.
- Deployed Prometheus exporters and dashboards to monitor application and infrastructure metrics; tuned alert thresholds to cut false positives.
- Used S3 for artifact storage and Lambda-based automation for lightweight operational tasks; coordinated releases and tracked work in Jira.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Engineering, MPSTME NMIMS
